description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 968/06, entering Faculty of Technological Studies to the Vavuniya Campus of the University of Jaffna
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - specifically, an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It involves the Minister exercising statutory powers to modify the schedule of the Act regarding the establishment of academic faculties and departments. While it mentions a government minister by name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the exercise of legal authority to amend existing legislation and regulations governing university structures.
